hints.tr: `restore-keys: |` ve altında bir satır içeride `pip-${{ runner.os }}-`.
hints.en: `restore-keys: |` and, one level in below it, `pip-${{ runner.os }}-`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-${{ runner.os }}-
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
